Lia: Quick sync — planning today's release train for runtime, model-router, and console. Target window 16:00-17:30 PT. Need owners for deploy + smoke + rollback readiness. Can everyone confirm slots?

Samir: I can own runtime deploy. Proposed: runtime v1.14.0 at 16:05 PT, canary 10% for 20m -> then 100% if stable. I'll run the smoke script and keep the previous image tag around for immediate rollback.

Devon: I'll take console. Slot 16:35 PT. Heads-up: there's a small DB migration (non-blocking) — I'll run migrate --noop then apply. Smoke owner: me + QA.

Maya: I'll handle model-router. Slot 16:20 PT, canary 5% for 10m, then 25% for 10m before full. Smoke: quick traffic routing checks and reranking latency test.

Lia: thanks. Priya, can you be on oncall watch for the window? We'll need metric thresholds and rollback authority.

Priya: Yep, I'll cover 15:45-18:00 PT. Rollback trigger thresholds:
- P50 latency increase > 200ms vs baseline for 5m
- Error rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m
- Canary traffic saturation showing >10% request failures
If any of the above, I'll coordinate rollback. I have permission to execute rollback for runtime and model-router; Devon will have console rollback controls.

Samir: Smoke checklist I'll run (posting commands):
```
# runtime smoke checks
curl -sfS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://internal-api.redwood/v1/health || exit 1
python tools/smoke/prefix_kv_check.py --model gptj-6b --max-latency-ms 800
# basic inference call
curl -sS -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":8}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" | jq .choices[0].text
```
I'll also tail logs: `kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=runtime --since=10m` and have the previous image tag pinned: `runtime:1.13.9`. Rollback command I'll use if needed: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n redwood` then pin the older image.

Maya: Router smoke quicks:
```
# sanity route check
curl -sS https://router.internal/route-check | jq .ok
# run 100 short requests with latency measurement
python tools/smoke/router_load.py --requests 100 --model gptj-6b --max-p99 1200
```
If reranking latency spikes > 250ms it's an auto-fail.

Devon: Console migration steps:
1) run `bin/migrate --noop` and verify no destructive ops
2) create db backup snapshot
3) apply migration and watch schema check script `tools/db/schema_check.py`
Smoke: open dashboard load, create a test org, run a settings toggle flow. Rollback: redeploy previous console image `console:20240211` and revert DB migration (we have a reversible migration).
